questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she [finish] her homework before dinner.
Select the correct option to complete the sentence: By the time they arrive, we ________ everything ready.
Which sentence correctly reports the statement: 'I am going to the cinema tonight.'?
options: 'I am going to the cinema tonight.' he said.
He said that he was going to the cinema that night.
He said that he was going to the cinema tonight.
He said that he would go to the cinema that night.
questions.answer: He said that he was going to the cinema that night.

questions.question: Choose the correct reported speech form: 'If I find her number, I'll call her.'
options: He said that if he found her number, he would call her.
He said that if he had found her number, he would call her.
He said that if he would find her number, he would call her.
He said that if he finds her number, he would call her.
questions.answer: He said that if he found her number, he would call her.

options: The letter was written by John.
The letter was wrote by John.
The letter is written by John.
questions.answer: The letter was written by John.
